macro: persistent wrong registry -> pre-chapter gate -> textbook lookup -> same-question retry
principles: Any question missed at least once remains in the permanent wrong-answer registry even after later mastery.
Before Day 2-18 starts, up to three wrong questions from any earlier Day can be resurfaced regardless of current chapter topic.
A repeated wrong in the gate must not reveal the answer, explanation, recovery clue, O/X answer, or answer keyword before textbook lookup.
Textbook page numbers are never fabricated.
After textbook lookup, the learner retries the same original question; brief explanation is allowed only after a correct retry.
A later source-learning wrong reopens a previously resolved registry record.
A chapter-gate pass is valid only for the exact source-wrong revision that existed when the learner passed it.

day1_to_day6.policy: Use audited problem ID -> page/question-number mappings where page exists.

day7_to_day18.policy: Do not guess pages; show unit -> chapter -> section/list only.

locator.gate_answer_leak_policy: Locator guide is rendered with includeKeywords=false before the learner answers correctly.

registry.retention: Records are never deleted on mastery; status changes between open/book-retry/recurring/resolved.
registry.reopen_policy: If a source-learning wrong occurs after resolvedAt, resolvedAt is cleared and the record reopens. Repeated historical gate failures retain recurring severity.
registry.source_revision: sourceRevisionBefore(targetDay) fingerprints only uid + source wrongCount + source lastWrongAt. Gate attempts do not independently invalidate a pass.

pre_chapter_gate.selection: up to three historical wrongs from earlier Days
pre_chapter_gate.bypass_prevention: guard is attached to actual Day entry pages, not only the hub
pre_chapter_gate.pass_policy: PASS stores the current source-wrong revision. If earlier-Day source wrong history changes, the old PASS is invalid.
pre_chapter_gate.session_policy: Gate session stores the same revision. A revision mismatch rebuilds the selected wrong list instead of reusing stale uids.

day1_to_day6.policy: Reuse existing problem-specific metacog source question; intercept explain mode during bookGate only.

day7_to_day18.policy: Load the same fast content pipeline, including boost, accuracy patch and question-quality reorder.

after_correct: return to pre-chapter gate for next historical wrong

integration.load_order: textbook locator -> wrong registry -> registry sync -> gate guard
integration.config_loader: app_mode_config.js includes pre_chapter_wrong_gate.html as a student page
integration.fast_boot: fast_sync_boot.js switches to fast_book_gate_engine.js for bookGate=1
integration.firebase: registry key uses history2-* storage convention and is eligible for existing release sync

fixed_defects.problem: A record already marked resolved could remain resolved after a later source-learning wrong.
fixed_defects.fix: Compare source wrong timestamp with resolvedAt and reopen when the newer source wrong occurred after resolution.

fixed_defects.problem: A previously stored chapter PASS could permanently bypass the gate even after new earlier-Day wrongs were added.
fixed_defects.fix: Bind PASS and gate session to a deterministic source-wrong revision and invalidate/rebuild on mismatch.

static_checks: Day1-6 exact locator source is QUESTION_SOURCE_MAPPING_AUDIT.json rather than inferred page numbers.
Day7-18 fallback has page=null and verified=false.
gate locator suppresses keywords before correct retry.
Day1-6 gate reuses original metacog question via wrapper instead of copying 140 questions.
Day7-18 gate uses existing content and answer-key pipeline.
normal Day entry is guarded so the hub cannot be the only enforcement point.
registry sync completes before pre-chapter guard runs.
old PASS without revision is treated as invalid and upgraded through a new gate pass.
new source wrong history changes the revision; gate-only counters do not.
qa.limitation: No interactive browser with the learner's real localStorage/Firebase account state is available here. Visual click-through with a real stored wrong remains a separate runtime checkpoint.
